cohort: 362 women who gave birth to a live singleton fetus in a breech presentation at term
finding: Cervical ripening in women with a singleton fetus in breech presentation at term did not significantly increase the incidence of severe maternal or neonatal morbidity compared to other modes of labor.
mod_finding: Cervical ripening in women with a breech presentation at term did not significantly increase the incidence of severe maternal or neonatal morbidity compared to other modes of labor.
